title: Prediction market Kalshi announces lifetime ban against former Rep. George Santos

content:
Kalshi said it is the first lifetime ban the platform has issued.

The prediction market Kalshi has announced a lifetime ban against disgraced former Rep. George Santos, who previously settled a regulatory investigation into his trades with a hefty fine and a temporary ban from using prediction markets. 

Kalshi said it is the first lifetime ban the platform has issued.
